استوطنوا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْطَنُوا (istawṭanū) /is.taw.tˤa.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَوْطَنَ (istawṭana)
# اُسْتُوطِنُوا (ustūṭinū) /us.tuː.tˤi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْطَنَ (istawṭana)
# اِسْتَوْطِنُوا (istawṭinū) /is.taw.tˤi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْطَنَ (istawṭana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
